veggie shepherd s pie filling and delicious dinner also a perfect empty your fridge recipe you can add as many different veggies as you want it will only get healthier feel free to adjust the amounts or add remove ingredients just use whatever veggies you have at home really ingredients for the filling carrots x celery sticks x mushrooms g onion x garlic cloves crushed sundried tomatoes g ish sweetcorn can peas g ish thyme tsp stock cube flour to thicken the paste parsley ingredients for the top a mix of normal potatos and sweet potatos about small potatoes all together garlic cloves crushed butter milk any will do parmesan method chop the onion carrots celery mushrooms sundried tomatoes into small chunks cook the onion in olive oil for mins and once it starts becoming translucent add the carrots celery mushrooms and sundried tomatoes add garlic thyme salt and pepper cook everything for another mins or until veggies start to cook and add in a stock cube and a bit of water for the veggies to stew in while the sauce is cooking peel the potatoes and cut into medium pieces boil in salted water until the chunks are soft enough to be pierced with a fork drain the potatoes and add a knob of butter and a splash of milk grate some parmesan and add garlic salt and pepper mix it all together and adjust amounts of these ingredients as necessary depending on how many and how big your potatoes are as the sauce begins to reduce add sweetcorn and peas continue cooking until the sauce is of desired consistency feel free to use a bit of flour to thicken it at the end chop up a bunch of parsley and add into the stew pour the strew into an oven dish cover the top with your mashed potato and grate some more parmesan on top to get that lovely golden crust under the grill for mins et voila
